name: scheduling
deprecation_criterion: Superseded when scheduling moves to a different clock source (e.g. a native plugin cron API) or when the tick interval/route become config-driven and this slice's hardcoding is removed.
spec_change_reason: FT-E loop-redesign reconciliation: scheduling consumes the redesigned verify-integrate + work-intake contracts. VERIFY now reads cross_cutting_risk + writes cross_check (FT-B/D); _seed_context registers + seeds cross_cutting_risk (no-risk default) when TRIAGE or VERIFY is routed and cross_check when VERIFY is routed, fixing the TRIAGE/VERIFY tick ContractError crash. REVIEW is ADVISORY: review_verdicts is retired in favour of review_findings (FT-C) — make_review writes EMPTY review_findings, _seed_context/_SLOT_SCHEMAS/persistence migrate to review_findings, REVIEW_VERDICTS_KEY->REVIEW_FINDINGS_KEY, persisted_review_verdicts->persisted_review_findings. INTEGRATE is a thin merge reading ONLY verdicts (no review-approval read). review_findings flush through the terminal REPORT port on the same file_discoveries idempotency + dedup-vs-open path. AGENT_PORT_TEMPLATES['REVIEW'] writes review_findings.
